testcase.name: C-TLS-5 Bounded reconnect backoff
testcase.system-out: criterion: reconnect attempts follow base 1 s, factor 2, cap 300 s, full jitter (verified on attempt timestamps with clock scaling) measure clock_scale = 1 measure attempts_observed = 5 measure max_gap_s = 5.977 measure capped_gaps_checked = 0 evidence: DUT dev-a579c3dedb054a93 (esp32-host fw 1.0.0 code 10000, se_type software), bootstrap serial de52e60de65e6db8a9d06845d2ccfe75 evidence: enrolled {"cert_serial_hex":"1c2ae4d337c7be6581643cdb6b6f1cc0","not_after":1795466667,"se_type":"software"}; connected {"alpn":"mqtt","broker":"127.0.0.1","resumed":false,"session_present":false,"tls_version":"TLSv1.3"} evidence: connect_failed reasons (first 3): ["not_authorized", "not_authorized", "not_authorized"]; status.state=backoff observed: true evidence: gap_k <= min(300, 2^k) x scale [s]: 0.390<=1.000, 0.044<=2.000, 0.928<=4.000, 1.237<=8.000, 5.977<=16.000 warning: no clock scaling on this target: bound and jitter verified for 5 attempts (up to 16 s); the 300 s cap was not reached
